other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect metric weighting logic
other_failure_modes.description: The task specifies a custom metric (Weighted Mean Absolute Error) where samples should be weighted according to specific criteria (e.g., holiday vs. non-holiday weeks in this dataset). The agent implements sample weighting but uses an irrelevant heuristic (sum of sales per store-department) instead of the correct weighting scheme.

summary: The agent correctly handles temporal splitting, feature engineering, and prevents data leakage by fitting target statistics only on the training set. However, it fails to correctly implement the task's custom WMAE metric weighting (holiday weeks weighted 5x), instead inventing an arbitrary sample weight based on total store-department sales. It also only evaluates a single stochastic model run and uses solely L1 loss without assessing other metrics.
